title: Reuse a component with props
summary: An Astro component can read values from Astro.props.
introduction: An Astro component can read values from Astro.props. Your task: Render two BookCard components with different titles.
learningObjectives: Render two BookCard components with different titles.
Explain the example for reuse a component with props

blocks.text: An Astro component can read values from Astro.props. A parent passes those values as attributes on the component.
Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.
Read the code step by step

items: `Astro.props` holds values supplied to an Astro component or generated route at render time.

blocks.text: Import BookCard into a page and use <BookCard title="Moon Trip" /> to show the title.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: This is a component file, not a route. Import it in the page frontmatter before using its tag.
